|G2 rating |4\.6 / 5 across 78 reviews, with 15+ G2 badges including Spring 2026 Best Support |

Ordway is an AI-powered billing and revenue management platform for companies with recurring revenue business models and subscription or usage-based pricing. It brings subscription management, invoice generation, payment collection, accounts receivable, revenue recognition, and SaaS metrics reporting together on a shared platform.

Finance and revenue operations teams use Ordway to convert signed orders and customer usage into invoices, collect and reconcile payments, recognize revenue under ASC 606 and IFRS 15, and report SaaS metrics such as ARR, MRR, churn, and net revenue retention.
Ordway is designed for technology-centric businesses—including AI, SaaS, cloud, fintech, marketplaces, and subscription companies—that have outgrown spreadsheets or inflexible billing tools.

citations.title: Product Changelog
excerpts: ### **New Features for Subscription Management, Usage Based Billing, and Revenue Recognition**

Price usage the way your customers actually buy. Matrix pricing lets a single plan charge different rates based on the details of each usage event, so you can build tiered and volume discounts without spinning up a separate plan for every scenario.

You define up to two dimensions from your usage data, for example region and service tier, and set a price for each combination. When an event comes in, Ordway matches it to the right cell and prices it, and falls back to a default rate if nothing matches, so every event is always priced. Reusable templates let you apply the same structure across many charges.

This is how you offer graduated pricing, where the unit price drops as volume grows, or premium rates for premium tiers, all inside one clean plan. It captures more expansion revenue as customers scale, without leaving you a mess of plans to maintain.
